Until it passes, no 18-matrix residual-codec composition or 18-affine claim is allowed.

final_verdict.claim: Conditional on an independent audit authenticating the direct calibration, this kills the v1 exhaustive FP64-cross-moment stage0 architecture under its frozen runtime gate. It does not statistically test or kill any ABI/seed hypothesis.
final_verdict.allowed_next_action: Independent source-only audit of the exact direct-counter calibration and this bound decision. No v1 implementation or model access is allowed.
final_verdict.forbidden: No Qwen/model access, threshold relaxation, coordinate reduction, precision change, K change or ABI change. Any FP32 interval screen or smaller stage0 is a distinct v2.

normal_and_bf16_numeric_abi.box_muller_implementation: call the hash-bound curand_normal.h device-inline _curand_box_muller directly; do not substitute an algebraically equivalent transform
normal_and_bf16_numeric_abi.box_muller_reference_formula_for_review_: u=x*2^-32+2^-33; v=y*2^-32+2^-33; s=sqrtf(-2*logf(u)); __sincosf(2*pi*v,a,b); a*=s; b*=s. The bound header, not this paraphrase, is executable authority.

normal_and_bf16_numeric_abi.reference_comparison: bitwise raw normal4 float32 plus scaled BF16 against curand_init(seed64,sequence,O+4*j) followed by one curand_normal4, and against curand_init(seed64,sequence,O) followed by j+1 normal4 calls

fused_stage0_kernel.candidate_derivation: uint64 checked shard_base + local_index; require result <= UINT32_MAX; cast only serialized base to u32
fused_stage0_kernel.warp_assignment: one logical warp per candidate; lanes 0..31 own the 32 controls; lane 0 additionally owns source
fused_stage0_kernel.anchor_generation: For t=0..7, every warp lane l evaluates bundle 32*t+l once and retains its float4. In frozen t-major, generating-lane-major, value-lane order, shuffles broadcast all 128 widened BF16 values for moment accumulation before t advances. This uses all lanes for Philox/Box-Muller while generating each anchor exactly once.
fused_stage0_kernel.lane0_only_generator_path: forbidden in production; it may exist only as a labeled source-free calibration comparator
fused_stage0_kernel.sufficient_statistics: fixed-order float64 role-pooled fit and score moments distributed across lanes; decoded FP16 alpha and mu are used on score coordinates
fused_stage0_kernel.control_rule: all 33 domains search the identical three-ABI/base-seed family, coordinate nests, K values and total order; controls are descriptive matched searches, not an exchangeable randomization orbit
fused_stage0_kernel.metric_wire: finite capture rounded once to IEEE-754 binary32; negative zero canonicalized to positive zero
fused_stage0_kernel.nonfinite_action: abort the entire cell before top-K
fused_stage0_kernel.q_layout: 33 by 2^24 float32 scores for one ABI shard
fused_stage0_kernel.topk_implementation: custom deterministic radix-select reads metric bits and derives base seed from shard_base+index on demand; it may emit only retained (seed_u32,metric_f32) records
fused_stage0_kernel.metric_order: finite binary32 capture descending after -0 canonicalization
